   ZSearch HomeController::decorSearchItems(), theo engine đã thực sự phục vụ.

                var v = el.getAttribute('data-source-box');
                if (v && v.slice(-sfx.length) !== sfx && typeof el.setAttribute === 'function') {
                    el.setAttribute('data-source-box', v + sfx);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

            try {
                if (root && typeof root.querySelectorAll === 'function') {
                    var nodes = root.querySelectorAll('[data-source-box]');
                    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) tag(nodes[i]);

            <style data-name="switch-languages">.switch-component {
    border-radius: 32px;
    border: transparent solid 3px;
    background-color: transparent;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
}

.switch-language-text {
    font-weight: 500;
}

.switch-component .is-desktop.switch-language-text {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option {
    display: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 2000000;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.select-group-option.active {
    display: block !important;
    pointer-events: all;
}

.switch-language-background {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    background-color: rgba(11 11 11 / 50%);
}

.switch-language-content {
    background-color: #fff;
    border-radius: 5px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 10px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%), 0 16px 24px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 14%), 0 6px 30px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
    padding-bottom: 16px;
}

.close-switch {
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    color: var(--gray);
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
}

.close-switch:hover {
    color: var(--primary)
}

.switch-language-heading {
    padding: 16px 32px;
    font-weight: 500;
    position: relative;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--primary);
    user-select: none;
    margin-bottom: 12px;;
}

.switch-language-row {
    padding: 10px 32px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
}

/* Chế độ chỉ đổi tiền tệ (mở từ trang checkout): ẩn phần Country/Region, đổi tiêu đề */
.switch-heading-currency {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-heading-default {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-heading-currency {
    display: inline;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-language-row-country {
    display: none;
}

.switch-language-label {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--primary);
    min-width: 150px;
}

.switch-item {
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
}

.switch-item-selected  {
    padding: 8px 16px;
    min-height: 50px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    border: 2px solid var(--flash);
    transition: border-color 200ms ease-in-out;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.switch-item-selected:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary-lt);
}

.language-selected span {
    margin-right: 6px;
}

/* Cờ tiền tệ */
.currency-flag {
    border-radius: 3px;
    object-fit: cover;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.currency-selected .currency-flag {
    margin-right: 8px;
}

.switch-currency-item .currency-flag {
    margin-left: 8px;
}

.switch-list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background-color: #fff;
    border: 2px solid var(--flash);
    border-top: none;
    z-index: 2;
    display: none;
    max-height: 510px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}


.switch-item.active .switch-list {
    display: block;
    border-color: var(--primary-lt);
}

.switch-link {
    padding: 8px 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.switch-link:hover {
    color: var(--secondary);
}

.update-locale-update {
    border-radius: 24px;
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #6071ec;
    border: 2px solid #6071ec;
    margin-left: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.switch-item.active .switch-language-text {
    color: #6071ec;
}

.update-locale-cancel {
    border: 2px solid var(--primary-lt);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    outline: none;
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
    .switch-language-content {
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 500px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        top: 30%;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        padding-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .switch-list {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        position: absolute;
        top:  calc(100% - 1px);
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        background-color: #fff;
        border: 2px solid var(--flash);
        border-top: none;
        border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px;
        z-index: 2;
        display: none;

    .switch-link {

        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        width: 100%;

        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    var locale = "";

    function selectCurrencyHeader(currency, text) {
        currencySwitchHeader = currency;
        document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = text;
        document.getElementById("list-currency-show-header").checked = false;
    }

    function saveSwitchHeader() {
        if (currencySwitchHeader) {
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader("currency", currencySwitchHeader, 365);
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem('localization_scroll', window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0);
            } catch (e) {}
            if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
            }
            window.location.reload();
        }
    }

    // Khôi phục vị trí cuộn sau khi đổi tiền tệ reload (giữ nguyên chỗ đang đứng).
    // Apply nhiều lần vì checkout render bằng Angular async, chiều cao trang thay đổi.
    (function () {
        var saved = sessionStorage.getItem('localization_scroll');
        if (saved !== null) {
            var top = parseInt(saved, 10) || 0;
            sessionStorage.removeItem('localization_scroll');
            var apply = function () {
                var times = [0, 200, 500, 900, 1500];
                for (var i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
                    setTimeout(function () { window.scrollTo(0, top); }, times[i]);
                }
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                        history.scrollRestoration = 'auto';
                    }
                }, 1700);
            };
            if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
                apply();
            } else {
                window.addEventListener('load', apply);
            }
        }
    })();

    function getCookieSelectCountryHeader(name) {
        let isSelectCountry = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) isSelectCountry = true;
        return isSelectCountry;
    }

    function getCookieHeader(name) {
        let cookieValue = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            cookieValue = parts[1];
        }
        return cookieValue;
    }

    function closeCountryHeader() {
        document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.remove("active");
        setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
    }

    function setCookieSelectCountryHeader(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
    }

    let isShowByCookie = false;
    if (!getCookieSelectCountryHeader("is_currency_selected")) {
        if (document.getElementById("header-select-country")) {
            isShowByCookie = true;
        }
    }

    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', url + '/localization/info', true);

    xhr.onload = function () {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
            var responseData = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
            if (responseData.status == 'successful') {
                let result = responseData.result;
                let isMismatch = result['countryByIp'] && result['countryByIp'].toLowerCase() != result['currentLocale'];
                let isShowHeader = result['isShow'] && isMismatch ? 1 : 0;

                if (document.getElementById("header-select-country") && isShowHeader == 1 && isShowByCookie) {
                    currencySwitchHeader = result['currencyByCountry'];
                    let displayText = currencySwitchHeader;
                    if (listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader]) {
                        let c = listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader];
                        displayText = c.symbol + ' ' + c.symbolText + ' (' + currencySwitchHeader + ')';
                    }
                    document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = displayText;
                    document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.add("active");
                }
            }
        } else {
            console.error('Request failed with status: ' + xhr.status);
        }
    };

    xhr.onerror = function () {
        console.error('Network error occurred');
    };

    xhr.send();
</script>

    (function () {
        window.clarity = window.clarity || function () { (window.clarity.q = window.clarity.q || []).push(arguments); };
        var reported = {};

        function stripQuery(url) {
            return String(url).split('?')[0];
        }

        function track(event, tags, key) {
            if (reported[key]) return;
            reported[key] = true;
            try {
                for (var name in tags) {
                    if (tags.hasOwnProperty(name)) window.clarity('set', name, tags[name]);
                }
                window.clarity('event', event);
            } catch (err) {}
        }

        function resourceStatus(url) {
            try {
                var entries = window.performance && performance.getEntriesByName ? performance.getEntriesByName(url) : [];
                var last = entries[entries.length - 1];
                if (last && typeof last.responseStatus === 'number') return String(last.responseStatus);
            } catch (err) {}
            return 'unknown';
        }

        function report403(url) {
            var clean = stripQuery(url);
            track('request_403', { forbidden_request: clean }, '403:' + clean);
        }

        // Script/CSS tải lỗi (kể cả 403/404/5xx). Bắt ở capture phase vì error của tài nguyên không nổi bọt.
        window.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
            var el = e.target;
            if (!el || el === window || !el.tagName) return;
            var tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
            var url = tag === 'script' ? el.src : (tag === 'link' && el.rel === 'stylesheet' ? el.href : '');
            if (!url) return;
            var clean = stripQuery(url);
            var status = resourceStatus(url);
            track('asset_load_failed', { failed_asset: clean, failed_asset_status: status }, 'asset:' + clean);
            if (status === '403') report403(url);
        }, true);

        // XHR (Angular $http, jQuery.ajax) trả về 403.
        var XHR = window.XMLHttpRequest;
        if (XHR && XHR.prototype) {
            var origOpen = XHR.prototype.open;
            var origSend = XHR.prototype.send;
            XHR.prototype.open = function (method, url) {
                this.__monitorUrl = url;
                return origOpen.apply(this, arguments);
            };
            XHR.prototype.send = function () {
                var xhr = this;
                try {
                    xhr.addEventListener('loadend', function () {
                        if (xhr.status === 403) report403(xhr.responseURL || xhr.__monitorUrl);
                    });
                } catch (err) {}
                return origSend.apply(this, arguments);
            };
        }

        // fetch trả về 403.
        if (window.fetch) {
            var origFetch = window.fetch;
            window.fetch = function (input) {
                var url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input && input.url) || String(input);
                return origFetch.apply(this, arguments).then(function (response) {
                    if (response && response.status === 403) report403(response.url || url);
                    return response;
                });
            };
        }

<script>
/* Tagger data-source-box của A/B "Search vs RCM" (đã gỡ).
   Thí nghiệm đó đổi CẢ search lẫn RCM (nhánh B = Elastic + RCM V1) nên gắn hậu
   tố lên mọi data-source-box là đúng. A/B đang chạy bây giờ là Vertex-vs-Typesense,
   CHỈ đổi search — gắn nhãn lên box RCM sẽ đẻ ra tracking_value rác kiểu
   'also-like--v', 'bought-together--v' và cắt đôi thống kê RCM vô cớ.
   Vì vậy nguồn hậu tố ở đây để rỗng; nhãn nhánh search giờ dán ở server, trong
   ZSearch HomeController::decorSearchItems(), theo engine đã thực sự phục vụ.
   window.__AB_SUFFIX vẫn giữ vì Cart/make-change.js còn đọc.
   Toàn bộ bọc try/catch + guard từng thao tác -> KHÔNG BAO GIỜ throw. */
(function () {
    try {
        try {
            window.__AB_SUFFIX = "";
        } catch (e) { return; }

        var sfx = window.__AB_SUFFIX;
        if (!sfx || typeof sfx !== 'string') return;   // '' khi tắt A/B -> không đụng gì

        function tag(el) {
            try {
                if (!el || typeof el.getAttribute !== 'function') return;
                var v = el.getAttribute('data-source-box');
                if (v && v.slice(-sfx.length) !== sfx && typeof el.setAttribute === 'function') {
                    el.setAttribute('data-source-box', v + sfx);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        function sweep(root) {
            try {
                if (root && typeof root.querySelectorAll === 'function') {
                    var nodes = root.querySelectorAll('[data-source-box]');
                    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) tag(nodes[i]);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        try {
            if (document && typeof document.addEventListener === 'function') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { sweep(document); });
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        // RCM box render bất đồng bộ + item.blade.php set data-source-box động.
        try {
            if (typeof MutationObserver === 'function' && document && document.documentElement) {
                var mo = new MutationObserver(function (muts) {
                    try {
                        for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
                            var m = muts[i];
                            if (m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && typeof m.target.hasAttribute === 'function'
                                && m.target.hasAttribute('data-source-box')) {
                                tag(m.target);
                            }
                            if (m.addedNodes) {
                                for (var j = 0; j < m.addedNodes.length; j++) {
                                    var n = m.addedNodes[j];
                                    if (n && n.nodeType === 1) {
                                        if (typeof n.hasAttribute === 'function' && n.hasAttribute('data-source-box')) tag(n);
                                        sweep(n);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {}
                });
                mo.observe(document.documentElement, {
                    childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-source-box']
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>

    function barOffset() {

    function geoAllowed(cb) {
        // GEO_GATE = false: popup hien theo duong dan trang, khong loc IP (Frank chot 15/10 17:54 VN dung loc IP).
        if (!GEO_GATE) {

        currencySwitchHeader = currency;
        document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = text;
        document.getElementById("list-currency-show-header").checked = false;
    }

    function saveSwitchHeader() {
        if (currencySwitchHeader) {
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader("currency", currencySwitchHeader, 365);
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem('localization_scroll', window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0);
            } catch (e) {}
            if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
            }
            window.location.reload();
        }
    }

    // Khôi phục vị trí cuộn sau khi đổi tiền tệ reload (giữ nguyên chỗ đang đứng).
    // Apply nhiều lần vì checkout render bằng Angular async, chiều cao trang thay đổi.
    (function () {
        var saved = sessionStorage.getItem('localization_scroll');
        if (saved !== null) {
            var top = parseInt(saved, 10) || 0;
            sessionStorage.removeItem('localization_scroll');
            var apply = function () {
                var times = [0, 200, 500, 900, 1500];
                for (var i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
                    setTimeout(function () { window.scrollTo(0, top); }, times[i]);
                }
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                        history.scrollRestoration = 'auto';
                    }
                }, 1700);
            };
            if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
                apply();
            } else {
                window.addEventListener('load', apply);
            }
        }
    })();

    function getCookieSelectCountryHeader(name) {
        let isSelectCountry = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) isSelectCountry = true;
        return isSelectCountry;
    }

    function getCookieHeader(name) {
        let cookieValue = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            cookieValue = parts[1];
        }
        return cookieValue;
    }

    function closeCountryHeader() {
        document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.remove("active");
        setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
    }

    function setCookieSelectCountryHeader(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
    }

    let isShowByCookie = false;
    if (!getCookieSelectCountryHeader("is_currency_selected")) {
        if (document.getElementById("header-select-country")) {
            isShowByCookie = true;

    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', url + '/localization/info', true);

    xhr.onload = function () {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
            var responseData = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
            if (responseData.status == 'successful') {
                let result = responseData.result;
                let isMismatch = result['countryByIp'] && result['countryByIp'].toLowerCase() != result['currentLocale'];
                let isShowHeader = result['isShow'] && isMismatch ? 1 : 0;

                if (document.getElementById("header-select-country") && isShowHeader == 1 && isShowByCookie) {
                    currencySwitchHeader = result['currencyByCountry'];
                    let displayText = currencySwitchHeader;
                    if (listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader]) {

                    }
                    document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = displayText;
                    document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.add("active");
                }
            }
        } else {
            console.error('Request failed with status: ' + xhr.status);
        }
    };

    (function () {
        window.clarity = window.clarity || function () { (window.clarity.q = window.clarity.q || []).push(arguments); };
        var reported = {};

        function stripQuery(url) {
            return String(url).split('?')[0];
        }

        function track(event, tags, key) {
            if (reported[key]) return;
            reported[key] = true;
            try {
                for (var name in tags) {
                    if (tags.hasOwnProperty(name)) window.clarity('set', name, tags[name]);
                }
                window.clarity('event', event);
            } catch (err) {}
        }

        function resourceStatus(url) {
            try {
                var entries = window.performance && performance.getEntriesByName ? performance.getEntriesByName(url) : [];
                var last = entries[entries.length - 1];
                if (last && typeof last.responseStatus === 'number') return String(last.responseStatus);
            } catch (err) {}
            return 'unknown';
        }

        function report403(url) {
            var clean = stripQuery(url);
            track('request_403', { forbidden_request: clean }, '403:' + clean);
        }

        // Script/CSS tải lỗi (kể cả 403/404/5xx). Bắt ở capture phase vì error của tài nguyên không nổi bọt.
        window.addEventListener('error', function (e) {
            var el = e.target;
            if (!el || el === window || !el.tagName) return;
            var tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
            var url = tag === 'script' ? el.src : (tag === 'link' && el.rel === 'stylesheet' ? el.href : '');
            if (!url) return;
            var clean = stripQuery(url);
            var status = resourceStatus(url);
            track('asset_load_failed', { failed_asset: clean, failed_asset_status: status }, 'asset:' + clean);
            if (status === '403') report403(url);
        }, true);

        // XHR (Angular $http, jQuery.ajax) trả về 403.
        var XHR = window.XMLHttpRequest;
        if (XHR && XHR.prototype) {
            var origOpen = XHR.prototype.open;
            var origSend = XHR.prototype.send;
            XHR.prototype.open = function (method, url) {
                this.__monitorUrl = url;
                return origOpen.apply(this, arguments);
            };
            XHR.prototype.send = function () {
                var xhr = this;
                try {
                    xhr.addEventListener('loadend', function () {
                        if (xhr.status === 403) report403(xhr.responseURL || xhr.__monitorUrl);
                    });
                } catch (err) {}
                return origSend.apply(this, arguments);
            };
        }

        // fetch trả về 403.
        if (window.fetch) {
            var origFetch = window.fetch;
            window.fetch = function (input) {
                var url = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input && input.url) || String(input);
                return origFetch.apply(this, arguments).then(function (response) {
                    if (response && response.status === 403) report403(response.url || url);
                    return response;
                });
            };
        }
    })();
</script>
<script>
(function () {
    try {
        var urlSourceBoxes = {'bought-together': 1, 'bought-together-b': 1, 'also-available': 1, 'also-available-b': 1, 'recently-viewed': 1};
        var addSourceToLink = function (event) {
            try {
                // Right click (button 2) would put the parameter into "Copy link" / shared URLs.
                if (event.type === 'mousedown' && event.button !== 0 && event.button !== 1) return;
                var target = event.target;
                if (!target || typeof target.closest !== 'function') return;
                var link = target.closest('a[data-source-box]');
                if (!link) return;
                var source = link.getAttribute('data-source-box');
                if (!source || !urlSourceBoxes.hasOwnProperty(source)) return;
                var href = link.getAttribute('href');
                if (!href || href.charAt(0) === '#' || /^javascript:/i.test(href) || href.indexOf('internal_source=') >= 0) return;
                // also-available CTA to the design tool is not a product card.
                if (href.indexOf('/create-your-own') >= 0) return;
                var hash = '';
                var hashIndex = href.indexOf('#');
                if (hashIndex >= 0) {
                    hash = href.substring(hashIndex);
                    href = href.substring(0, hashIndex);
                }
                link.setAttribute('href', href + (href.indexOf('?') >= 0 ? '&' : '?') + 'internal_source=' + encodeURIComponent(source) + hash);
            } catch (error) {}
        };
        document.addEventListener('mousedown', addSourceToLink, true);
        document.addEventListener('click', addSourceToLink, true);
    } catch (error) {}
})();
</script>
<script>
/* Tagger data-source-box của A/B "Search vs RCM" (đã gỡ).
   Thí nghiệm đó đổi CẢ search lẫn RCM (nhánh B = Elastic + RCM V1) nên gắn hậu
   tố lên mọi data-source-box là đúng. A/B đang chạy bây giờ là Vertex-vs-Typesense,
   CHỈ đổi search — gắn nhãn lên box RCM sẽ đẻ ra tracking_value rác kiểu
   'also-like--v', 'bought-together--v' và cắt đôi thống kê RCM vô cớ.
   Vì vậy nguồn hậu tố ở đây để rỗng; nhãn nhánh search giờ dán ở server, trong
   ZSearch HomeController::decorSearchItems(), theo engine đã thực sự phục vụ.
   window.__AB_SUFFIX vẫn giữ vì Cart/make-change.js còn đọc.
   Toàn bộ bọc try/catch + guard từng thao tác -> KHÔNG BAO GIỜ throw. */
(function () {
    try {
        try {
            window.__AB_SUFFIX = "";
        } catch (e) { return; }

        var sfx = window.__AB_SUFFIX;
        if (!sfx || typeof sfx !== 'string') return;   // '' khi tắt A/B -> không đụng gì

        function tag(el) {
            try {
                if (!el || typeof el.getAttribute !== 'function') return;
                var v = el.getAttribute('data-source-box');
                if (v && v.slice(-sfx.length) !== sfx && typeof el.setAttribute === 'function') {
                    el.setAttribute('data-source-box', v + sfx);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        function sweep(root) {
            try {
                if (root && typeof root.querySelectorAll === 'function') {
                    var nodes = root.querySelectorAll('[data-source-box]');
                    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) tag(nodes[i]);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        try {
            if (document && typeof document.addEventListener === 'function') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { sweep(document); });
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        // RCM box render bất đồng bộ + item.blade.php set data-source-box động.
        try {
            if (typeof MutationObserver === 'function' && document && document.documentElement) {
                var mo = new MutationObserver(function (muts) {
                    try {
                        for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
                            var m = muts[i];
                            if (m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && typeof m.target.hasAttribute === 'function'
                                && m.target.hasAttribute('data-source-box')) {
                                tag(m.target);
                            }
                            if (m.addedNodes) {
                                for (var j = 0; j < m.addedNodes.length; j++) {
                                    var n = m.addedNodes[j];
                                    if (n && n.nodeType === 1) {
                                        if (typeof n.hasAttribute === 'function' && n.hasAttribute('data-source-box')) tag(n);
                                        sweep(n);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {}
                });
                mo.observe(document.documentElement, {
                    childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-source-box']
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>

        referHost = document.referrer;

    const TOKEN_USER_QUERY_KEY = 'token_user_query';
    document.addEventListener("created-order", function (event) {

    function trackingLastClick(referHost, fullUrl, host, token) {
        // empty clickerDomain (bot pool) would POST to relative /t/ts on the site itself -> 404
        if (!clickerDomain) return;
        fetch(clickerDomain + "/t/ts", {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Accept': 'application/json',
                'Content-Type': 'application/json'
            },
            credentials: 'include',
            body: JSON.stringify({
                url: encodeURIComponent(fullUrl),
                referHost: referHost,
                host: host,
                _token: token
            })
        }).then(function (response) {

            } catch (e) {}

            console.warn('trackingLastClick exception');
        });

    function makeToken(length) {
        var result           = '';
        var characters       = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789';
        var charactersLength = characters.length;
        for ( var i = 0; i < length; i++ ) {
            result += characters.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * charactersLength));
        }
        result += Date.now();
        return result;
    }

    function persistToken(token) {
        try {
            localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_USER_QUERY_KEY, token);
        } catch (e) {}
        setCookie(TOKEN_USER_QUERY_KEY, token);
    }

    function getToken() {
        try {
            var stored = localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_USER_QUERY_KEY) || getCookie(TOKEN_USER_QUERY_KEY);
            if (stored && stored.length >= 40) return stored;
        } catch (e) {}

        var token = makeToken(40);
        persistToken(token);
        return token;
    }

    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
        if (days) {
            var date = new Date();
            date.setTime(date.getTime() + (days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
            var expires = "; expires=" + date.toGMTString();
        } else {
            var expires = "";
        }
        document.cookie = name + "=" + value + expires + "; path=/";
    }

    function getCookie(name) {
        var nameEQ = name + "=";
        var ca = document.cookie.split(';');
        for (var i = 0; i < ca.length; i++) {
            var c = ca[i];
            while (c.charAt(0) == ' ') {
                c = c.substring(1, c.length);
            }
            if (c.indexOf(nameEQ) == 0) {
                return c.substring(nameEQ.length, c.length);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    function ready(callback) {
        if (document.readyState!='loading') callback();
        else if (document.addEventListener) document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', callback);
        else document.attachEvent('onreadystatechange', function(){
            if (document.readyState=='complete') callback();
        });
    }

    ready(function () {
        if (typeof referHost == 'undefined') referHost = '';
        if (typeof fullUrl == 'undefined') fullUrl = '';
        if (typeof host == 'undefined') host = '';

        var token = getToken();
        trackingLastClick(referHost, fullUrl, host, token);
        if (window.location.pathname.includes('/checkout')) {
            fetch('/tracking-order/build-tracking-source?token=' + token).then(function (response) {
                return response.json();
            }).then(function (data) {
                console.log('build-tracking-source success');
            }).catch(function (err) {
                console.error('build-tracking-source exception', err);
            });
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            const link = e.target.closest('[data-source-box]');

            if (isNewTab) {
                e.preventDefault();
                window.open(link.href, '_blank');
            }
        });
    });

            <style data-name="switch-languages">.switch-component {
    border-radius: 32px;
    border: transparent solid 3px;
    background-color: transparent;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    user-select: none;
}

.switch-language-text {
    font-weight: 500;
}

.switch-component .is-desktop.switch-language-text {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option {
    display: none;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: fixed;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 2000000;
    pointer-events: none;
}

.select-group-option.active {
    display: block !important;
    pointer-events: all;
}

.switch-language-background {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: 0;
    z-index: 1;
    background-color: rgba(11 11 11 / 50%);
}

.switch-language-content {
    background-color: #fff;
    border-radius: 5px;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 10px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%), 0 16px 24px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 14%), 0 6px 30px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
    padding-bottom: 16px;
}

.close-switch {
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    color: var(--gray);
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
}

.close-switch:hover {
    color: var(--primary)
}

.switch-language-heading {
    padding: 16px 32px;
    font-weight: 500;
    position: relative;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--primary);
    user-select: none;
    margin-bottom: 12px;;
}

.switch-language-row {
    padding: 10px 32px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
}

/* Chế độ chỉ đổi tiền tệ (mở từ trang checkout): ẩn phần Country/Region, đổi tiêu đề */
.switch-heading-currency {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-heading-default {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-heading-currency {
    display: inline;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-language-row-country {
    display: none;
}

.switch-language-label {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--primary);
    min-width: 150px;
}

.switch-item {
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
}

.switch-item-selected  {
    padding: 8px 16px;
    min-height: 50px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    border: 2px solid var(--flash);
    transition: border-color 200ms ease-in-out;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.switch-item-selected:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary-lt);
}

.language-selected span {
    margin-right: 6px;
}

/* Cờ tiền tệ */
.currency-flag {
    border-radius: 3px;
    object-fit: cover;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.currency-selected .currency-flag {
    margin-right: 8px;
}

.switch-currency-item .currency-flag {
    margin-left: 8px;
}

.switch-list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background-color: #fff;
    border: 2px solid var(--flash);
    border-top: none;
    z-index: 2;
    display: none;
    max-height: 510px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}


.switch-item.active .switch-list {
    display: block;
    border-color: var(--primary-lt);
}

.switch-link {
    padding: 8px 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.switch-link:hover {
    color: var(--secondary);
}

.update-locale-update {
    border-radius: 24px;
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #6071ec;
    border: 2px solid #6071ec;
    margin-left: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.switch-item.active .switch-language-text {
    color: #6071ec;
}

.update-locale-cancel {
    border: 2px solid var(--primary-lt);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    outline: none;
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
    .switch-language-content {
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 500px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        top: 30%;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        padding-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .switch-list {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;

        top:  calc(100% - 1px);
        left: 0;

        border: 2px solid var(--flash);
        border-top: none;
        border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px;

        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;

    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-list {
        display: block;
        border-color: var(--primary-lt);
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-item-selected {
        border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0;
        border-color: var(--primary-lt)
    }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
    .switch-language-content {
        width: 100%;
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 2;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        padding-bottom: 16px;
        transform: translateY(110%);
        transition: transform 300ms ease-in-out;
    }

    .select-group-option.active .switch-language-content {
        transform: translateY(0%);
    }

    .switch-language-row {
        flex-flow: wrap;
    }

    .switch-list {
        bottom:  calc(100% - 1px);
        border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0 ;
        display: none;
        bottom: calc(100% - 1px)
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-item-selected {
        border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px ;
        border-color: var(--primary-lt)
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-list {
        max-height: 420px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }

    var locale = "";

    var currencySwitchHeader = '';
    var listCurrencyMap = {"USD":{"symbol":"$","symbolText":"US Dollar"},"EUR":{"symbol":"\u20ac","symbolText":"Euro"},"GBP":{"symbol":"\u00a3","symbolText":"Pound Sterling"},"CAD":{"symbol":"CA$","symbolText":"Canadian dollar"},"AUD":{"symbol":"AU$","symbolText":"Australian Dollar"},"JPY":{"symbol":"\u00a5","symbolText":"Japanese yen"},"VND":{"symbol":"\u20ab","symbolText":"Vietnam dong"},"KRW":{"symbol":"\u20a9","symbolText":"South Korean won"},"PLN":{"symbol":"z\u0142","symbolText":"Polish zloty"},"MXN":{"symbol":"Mex$","symbolText":"Mexican peso"},"BRL":{"symbol":"R$","symbolText":"Brazilian Real"}};

    function selectCurrencyHeader(currency, text) {
        currencySwitchHeader = currency;
        document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = text;
        document.getElementById("list-currency-show-header").checked = false;
    }

    function saveSwitchHeader() {
        if (currencySwitchHeader) {
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader("currency", currencySwitchHeader, 365);
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem('localization_scroll', window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0);
            } catch (e) {}
            if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
            }
            window.location.reload();
        }
    }

    // Khôi phục vị trí cuộn sau khi đổi tiền tệ reload (giữ nguyên chỗ đang đứng).
    // Apply nhiều lần vì checkout render bằng Angular async, chiều cao trang thay đổi.
    (function () {
        var saved = sessionStorage.getItem('localization_scroll');
        if (saved !== null) {
            var top = parseInt(saved, 10) || 0;
            sessionStorage.removeItem('localization_scroll');
            var apply = function () {
                var times = [0, 200, 500, 900, 1500];
                for (var i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
                    setTimeout(function () { window.scrollTo(0, top); }, times[i]);
                }
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                        history.scrollRestoration = 'auto';
                    }
                }, 1700);
            };
            if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
                apply();
            } else {
                window.addEventListener('load', apply);
            }
        }
    })();

    function getCookieSelectCountryHeader(name) {
        let isSelectCountry = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) isSelectCountry = true;
        return isSelectCountry;
    }

    function getCookieHeader(name) {
        let cookieValue = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            cookieValue = parts[1];
        }
        return cookieValue;
    }

    function closeCountryHeader() {
        document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.remove("active");
        setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
    }

    function setCookieSelectCountryHeader(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
    }

    let isShowByCookie = false;
    if (!getCookieSelectCountryHeader("is_currency_selected")) {
        if (document.getElementById("header-select-country")) {
            isShowByCookie = true;
        }
    }

    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', url + '/localization/info', true);

    xhr.onload = function () {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
            var responseData = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
            if (responseData.status == 'successful') {
                let result = responseData.result;
                let isMismatch = result['countryByIp'] && result['countryByIp'].toLowerCase() != result['currentLocale'];
                let isShowHeader = result['isShow'] && isMismatch ? 1 : 0;

                if (document.getElementById("header-select-country") && isShowHeader == 1 && isShowByCookie) {
                    currencySwitchHeader = result['currencyByCountry'];
                    let displayText = currencySwitchHeader;
                    if (listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader]) {
                        let c = listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader];
                        displayText = c.symbol + ' ' + c.symbolText + ' (' + currencySwitchHeader + ')';
                    }
                    document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = displayText;
                    document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.add("active");
                }
            }
        } else {
            console.error('Request failed with status: ' + xhr.status);
        }
    };

    xhr.onerror = function () {
        console.error('Network error occurred');
    };

    xhr.send();
</script>

<script>
/* Tagger data-source-box của A/B "Search vs RCM" (đã gỡ).
   Thí nghiệm đó đổi CẢ search lẫn RCM (nhánh B = Elastic + RCM V1) nên gắn hậu
   tố lên mọi data-source-box là đúng. A/B đang chạy bây giờ là Vertex-vs-Typesense,
   CHỈ đổi search — gắn nhãn lên box RCM sẽ đẻ ra tracking_value rác kiểu
   'also-like--v', 'bought-together--v' và cắt đôi thống kê RCM vô cớ.
   Vì vậy nguồn hậu tố ở đây để rỗng; nhãn nhánh search giờ dán ở server, trong
   ZSearch HomeController::decorSearchItems(), theo engine đã thực sự phục vụ.
   window.__AB_SUFFIX vẫn giữ vì Cart/make-change.js còn đọc.
   Toàn bộ bọc try/catch + guard từng thao tác -> KHÔNG BAO GIỜ throw. */
(function () {
    try {
        try {
            window.__AB_SUFFIX = "";
        } catch (e) { return; }

        var sfx = window.__AB_SUFFIX;
        if (!sfx || typeof sfx !== 'string') return;   // '' khi tắt A/B -> không đụng gì

        function tag(el) {
            try {
                if (!el || typeof el.getAttribute !== 'function') return;
                var v = el.getAttribute('data-source-box');
                if (v && v.slice(-sfx.length) !== sfx && typeof el.setAttribute === 'function') {
                    el.setAttribute('data-source-box', v + sfx);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }
        function sweep(root) {
            try {
                if (root && typeof root.querySelectorAll === 'function') {
                    var nodes = root.querySelectorAll('[data-source-box]');
                    for (var i = 0; i < nodes.length; i++) tag(nodes[i]);
                }
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        try {
            if (document && typeof document.addEventListener === 'function') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () { sweep(document); });
            }
        } catch (e) {}

        // RCM box render bất đồng bộ + item.blade.php set data-source-box động.
        try {
            if (typeof MutationObserver === 'function' && document && document.documentElement) {
                var mo = new MutationObserver(function (muts) {
                    try {
                        for (var i = 0; i < muts.length; i++) {
                            var m = muts[i];
                            if (m.type === 'attributes' && m.target && typeof m.target.hasAttribute === 'function'
                                && m.target.hasAttribute('data-source-box')) {
                                tag(m.target);
                            }
                            if (m.addedNodes) {
                                for (var j = 0; j < m.addedNodes.length; j++) {
                                    var n = m.addedNodes[j];
                                    if (n && n.nodeType === 1) {
                                        if (typeof n.hasAttribute === 'function' && n.hasAttribute('data-source-box')) tag(n);
                                        sweep(n);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (e) {}
                });
                mo.observe(document.documentElement, {
                    childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-source-box']
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {}
    } catch (e) {}
})();
</script>

    box-shadow: 0 8px 10px -5px rgb(0 0 0 / 20%), 0 16px 24px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 14%), 0 6px 30px 5px rgb(0 0 0 / 10%);
    padding-bottom: 16px;
}

.close-switch {
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    color: var(--gray);
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
}

.close-switch:hover {
    color: var(--primary)
}

.switch-language-heading {
    padding: 16px 32px;
    font-weight: 500;
    position: relative;
    font-size: 16px;
    color: var(--primary);
    user-select: none;
    margin-bottom: 12px;;
}

.switch-language-row {
    padding: 10px 32px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: center;
}

/* Chế độ chỉ đổi tiền tệ (mở từ trang checkout): ẩn phần Country/Region, đổi tiêu đề */
.switch-heading-currency {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-heading-default {
    display: none;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-heading-currency {
    display: inline;
}

.select-group-option.currency-only .switch-language-row-country {
    display: none;
}

.switch-language-label {
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--primary);
    min-width: 150px;
}

.switch-item {
    width: 100%;
    position: relative;
}

.switch-item-selected  {
    padding: 8px 16px;
    min-height: 50px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    border: 2px solid var(--flash);
    transition: border-color 200ms ease-in-out;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.switch-item-selected:hover {
    border-color: var(--primary-lt);
}

.language-selected span {
    margin-right: 6px;
}

/* Cờ tiền tệ */
.currency-flag {
    border-radius: 3px;
    object-fit: cover;
    flex-shrink: 0;
}

.currency-selected .currency-flag {
    margin-right: 8px;
}

.switch-currency-item .currency-flag {
    margin-left: 8px;
}

.switch-list {
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    background-color: #fff;
    border: 2px solid var(--flash);
    border-top: none;
    z-index: 2;
    display: none;
    max-height: 510px;
    overflow-y: auto;
}


.switch-item.active .switch-list {
    display: block;
    border-color: var(--primary-lt);
}

.switch-link {
    padding: 8px 24px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    width: 100%;
    user-select: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.switch-link:hover {
    color: var(--secondary);
}

.update-locale-update {
    border-radius: 24px;
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #6071ec;
    border: 2px solid #6071ec;
    margin-left: 10px;
    font-weight: 500;
}
.switch-item.active .switch-language-text {
    color: #6071ec;
}

.update-locale-cancel {
    border: 2px solid var(--primary-lt);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    outline: none;
}

@media (min-width: 760px) {
    .switch-language-content {
        width: 90%;
        max-width: 500px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 2;
        top: 30%;
        left: 50%;
        transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
        padding-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .switch-list {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        position: absolute;
        top:  calc(100% - 1px);
        left: 0;
        width: 100%;
        background-color: #fff;
        border: 2px solid var(--flash);
        border-top: none;
        border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px;
        z-index: 2;
        display: none;
    }

    .switch-link {
        padding: 8px 24px;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        width: 100%;
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-list {
        display: block;
        border-color: var(--primary-lt);
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-item-selected {
        border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0;
        border-color: var(--primary-lt)
    }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
    .switch-language-content {
        width: 100%;
        position: fixed;
        z-index: 2;
        bottom: 0;
        left: 0;
        padding-bottom: 16px;
        transform: translateY(110%);
        transition: transform 300ms ease-in-out;
    }

    .select-group-option.active .switch-language-content {
        transform: translateY(0%);
    }

    .switch-language-row {
        flex-flow: wrap;
    }

    .switch-list {
        bottom:  calc(100% - 1px);
        border-radius: 24px 24px 0 0 ;
        display: none;
        bottom: calc(100% - 1px)
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-item-selected {
        border-radius: 0 0 24px 24px ;
        border-color: var(--primary-lt)
    }

    .switch-item.active .switch-list {
        max-height: 420px;
        overflow-y: auto;
        overflow-x: hidden;
    }
}</style>

<script>
(function () {
    if (window.pvEpopInit) {

    var LOCALE = root.getAttribute('data-locale');

    var EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/;

    // Nuoc cua trang -> ma nuoc Cloudflare (loc=) cua IP khach.
    var GEO_GATE = true;
    var PREVIEW_ONLY = false;

    var pageLeaving = false;

    function lsGet(k) { try { return window.localStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
    function lsSet(k, v) { try { window.localStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} }
    function ssGet(k) { try { return window.sessionStorage.getItem(k); } catch (e) { return null; } }
    function ssSet(k, v) { try { window.sessionStorage.setItem(k, v); } catch (e) {} }
    function ssDel(k) { try { window.sessionStorage.removeItem(k); } catch (e) {} }

    // Mua (chu de theo dip): cau hinh tu server (#pv-epop-seasons), chon o trinh duyet vi HTML bi cache toi 24 h.
    var SEASONS = (function () {
        var el = document.getElementById('pv-epop-seasons');
        if (!el) {
            return [];
        }
        try {
            var list = JSON.parse(el.textContent || el.innerHTML || '[]');
            return Object.prototype.toString.call(list) === '[object Array]' ? list : [];
        } catch (e) {
            return [];
        }
    })();
    // ?pv_popup_season=<key|none> ghi de mua ca phien (QA chup tung mua); auto = bo ghi de.
    var seasonParam = /(?:^|[?&])pv_popup_season=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)(?:&|$)/.exec(window.location.search || '');
    if (seasonParam) {
        if (seasonParam[1].toLowerCase() === 'auto') {
            ssDel('pvPopupSeason');
        } else {
            ssSet('pvPopupSeason', seasonParam[1].toLowerCase());
        }
    }
    // Early Access BF26 (#450a6f28): o tick buoc 1 popup lon, chi US, Date.now() trong [00:00 ET 20/11, 08:00 ET 26/11/2026).
    // ?pv_popup_ea=1|0 ep bat/tat ca phien (sessionStorage pvPopupEa) cho QA; auto = bo ghi de.
    var EA_FROM = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 20, 5, 0, 0);
    var EA_TO = Date.UTC(2026, 10, 26, 13, 0, 0);
    var eaParam = /(?:^|[?&])pv_popup_ea=([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)(?:&|$)/.exec(window.location.search || '');
    if (eaParam) {
        if (eaParam[1].toLowerCase() === 'auto') {
            ssDel('pvPopupEa');
        } else {
            ssSet('pvPopupEa', eaParam[1] === '1' ? '1' : '0');
        }
    }
    var eaBox = root.querySelector('[data-epop-ea]');
    function eaActive() {
        if (!eaBox || LOCALE !== 'us') {
            return false;
        }
        var forced = ssGet('pvPopupEa');
        if (forced === '1' || forced === '0') {
            return forced === '1';
        }
        var t = now();
        return t >= EA_FROM && t < EA_TO;
    }
    // Goi luc mo popup (khong luc tai trang: trang co the mo lau qua moc gio).
    function applyEarlyAccess() {
        if (eaBox) {
            eaBox.hidden = !eaActive();
        }
    }
    function eaChecked() {
        var c = eaBox && !eaBox.hidden ? eaBox.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]') : null;
        return !!(c && c.checked);
    }
    var seasonPicked = false;
    var season = null;
    function findSeason(key) {
        for (var i = 0; i < SEASONS.length; i++) {
            if (SEASONS[i] && SEASONS[i].key === key) {
                return SEASONS[i];
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
    // Chon 1 lan moi trang, luc popup/widget mo lan dau (Date.now() trong [from_ms, to_ms)); khong khop -> null = mac dinh.
    function getSeason() {
        if (seasonPicked) {
            return season;
        }
        seasonPicked = true;
        var forced = ssGet('pvPopupSeason');
        if (forced === 'none') {
            return season;
        }
        if (forced) {
            season = findSeason(forced);
            if (season) {
                return season;
            }
        }
        var t = now();
        for (var i = 0; i < SEASONS.length; i++) {
            var s = SEASONS[i];
            if (s && typeof s.from_ms === 'number' && typeof s.to_ms === 'number' && t >= s.from_ms && t < s.to_ms) {
                season = s;
                break;
            }
        }
        return season;
    }
    function seasonKey() {
        var s = getSeason();
        return s && s.key ? s.key : 'default';
    }
    function setImg(img, pair) {
        if (!img || !pair || typeof pair[0] !== 'string' || !pair[0]) {
            return;
        }
        if (img.getAttribute('src') !== pair[0]) {
            img.setAttribute('src', pair[0]);
        }
        img.setAttribute('alt', typeof pair[1] === 'string' ? pair[1] : '');
    }
    function setSeasonLabel(el, s) {
        if (!el) {
            return;
        }
        var text = s && typeof s.eyebrow === 'string' ? s.eyebrow : '';
        el.textContent = text;
        el.hidden = !text;
    }
    // Doi anh chi khi popup mo (anh lazy, root dang hidden -> chua tai anh mac dinh).
    function applySeasonPopup() {
        var s = getSeason();
        setSeasonLabel(root.querySelector('[data-epop-season]'), s);
        if (!s) {
            return;
        }
        var imgs = root.querySelectorAll('.pv-epop__media img');
        var list = s.images && s.images.length ? s.images : [];
        for (var i = 0; i < imgs.length && i < list.length; i++) {
            setImg(imgs[i], list[i]);
        }
        setImg(root.querySelector('.pv-epop__hero img'), s.hero);
    }
    function applySeasonWidget() {
        setSeasonLabel(widget.querySelector('[data-ewid-season]'), getSeason());
    }

    function track(action, variant) {
        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
        window.dataLayer.push({event: 'email_popup', popup_action: action, popup_variant: variant, market: LOCALE, popup_season: seasonKey()});
    }
    function isSubscribed() {
        return lsGet('pvEcapSubscribed') === '1';
    }
    // Khach da dong popup lon trong 3 ngay qua (localStorage pvPopupClosedAt) -> khong tu mo lai.
    function closedRecently() {
        var t = parseInt(lsGet('pvPopupClosedAt') || '', 10);
        if (!t) {
            return false;
        }
        var d = now() - t;
        return d >= 0 && d < CLOSED_BLOCK_MS;
    }
    // Klaviyo da nhan dien khach (cookie __kla_id = base64 JSON co $exchange_id hoac $email) -> khong moi dang ky.
    function klaviyoKnown() {
        var m = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)__kla_id=([^;]+)/);
        if (!m) {
            return false;
        }
        try {
            var raw = decodeURIComponent(m[1]);
            var data = JSON.parse(window.atob(raw));
            return !!(data && (data.$exchange_id || data.$email));
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    function consentOpen() {
        var b = document.getElementById('consent-banner');
        if (b && ((' ' + b.className + ' ').indexOf(' consent-active ') !== -1 || b.style.display === 'block')) {
            return true;
        }
        // Hop chon tien te cua site (Localization header-select-country, class active) cung la popup -> khong chong len.
        var c = document.getElementById('header-select-country');
        if (c && (' ' + c.className + ' ').indexOf(' active ') !== -1) {
            return true;
        }
        return klaviyoFormOpen() || buyDialogOpen();
    }
    // Form popup/flyout cua Klaviyo dang hien (vd US 03/11/2026: form ViGMQp "Unlock Your MYSTERY DEAL") -> khong chong popup len.
    function klaviyoFormOpen() {
        var forms = document.querySelectorAll('[role="dialog"] form.klaviyo-form');
        for (var i = 0; i < forms.length; i++) {
            if (forms[i].offsetWidth || forms[i].offsetHeight) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    // Dialog mua hang / mini cart cua site dang mo -> popup hoan, widget an tam (z-index widget 90 < cac dialog nay).
    function buyDialogOpen() {
        var m = document.getElementById('show-mini-cart-wrapper');
        if (m && m.checked) {
            return true;
        }
        return !!document.querySelector('body.modal-open, .choose-variant-popup.active, .studio-popup-wrapper.active');
    }
    // Khach dang go/chon trong form cua trang (khong phai o cua popup) -> chua mo popup lon.
    function userTyping() {
        var a = document.activeElement;
        if (!a || a === document.body || root.contains(a) || widget.contains(a)) {
            return false;
        }
        var tag = (a.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
        if (tag === 'input') {
            // Chi o go chu; file/checkbox/radio/nut giu focus sau khi chon -> khong tinh la dang go (da co dieu kien file/3 s yen).
            return !/^(file|checkbox|radio|button|submit|reset|image|range|color|hidden)$/i.test(a.type || '');
        }
        return tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || a.isContentEditable === true;
    }
    function now() {
        return new Date().getTime();
    }
    // Popup lon chi mo khi: tab dang focus, khong dang chon file personalize, va >= 3 s khong co tuong tac (bam bien the...).
    function popupBlocked() {
        if (consentOpen() || userTyping()) {
            return true;
        }
        if (typeof document.hasFocus === 'function' && !document.hasFocus()) {
            return true;
        }
        var t = now();
        return t < filePickUntil || t - lastInteract < IDLE_BEFORE_POPUP;
    }
    function inOwnUi(el) {
        return !!el && el.nodeType === 1 && (root.contains(el) || widget.contains(el));
    }
    // input[type=file] duoc bam truc tiep hoac qua label (for=... / label boc input).
    function fileInputOf(el) {
        while (el && el.nodeType === 1) {
            var tag = (el.tagName || '').toLowerCase();
            if (tag === 'input') {
                return (el.type || '').toLowerCase() === 'file' ? el : null;
            }
            if (tag === 'label') {
                var c = el.htmlFor ? document.getElementById(el.htmlFor) : el.querySelector('input');
                return c && (c.type || '').toLowerCase() === 'file' ? c : null;
            }
            el = el.parentNode;
        }
        return null;
    }
    function onInteract(event) {
        if (inOwnUi(event.target)) {
            return;
        }
        lastInteract = now();
        if (event.type === 'click' && fileInputOf(event.target)) {
            filePickUntil = lastInteract + FILE_PICK_MAX;
        }
    }
    var interactEvents = ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart', 'click', 'keydown'];
    for (var ie = 0; ie < interactEvents.length; ie++) {
        document.addEventListener(interactEvents[ie], onInteract, true);
    }
    document.addEventListener('change', function (event) {
        var el = event.target;
        if (el && (el.type || '').toLowerCase() === 'file') {
            filePickUntil = 0;
            lastInteract = now();
        }
    }, true);
    function whenPopupAllowed(fn) {
        if (!popupBlocked()) {
            fn();
            return;
        }
        var t = window.setInterval(function () {
            if (!popupBlocked()) {
                window.clearInterval(t);
                fn();
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    // Popup consent cookie (z-index cao nhat) / hop chon tien te / dialog mua dang hien -> doi no dong roi moi hien.
    function whenConsentClosed(fn) {
        if (!consentOpen()) {
            fn();
            return;
        }
        var t = window.setInterval(function () {
            if (!consentOpen()) {
                window.clearInterval(t);
                fn();
            }
        }, 1000);
    }
    function setStatus(box, text, ok) {
        if (!box) {
            return;
        }
        box.className = box.className.replace(/\s*is-(ok|error)/g, '') + (text ? (ok ? ' is-ok' : ' is-error') : '');
        box.textContent = text || '';
    }
    function focusables() {
        var list = dialog.querySelectorAll('button, input:not([type="hidden"]), a[href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])');
        var out = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
            if (list[i].offsetWidth || list[i].offsetHeight) {
                out.push(list[i]);
            }
        }
        return out;
    }

    function openPopup(variant) {
        if (popupOpen || isSubscribed() || klaviyoKnown() || ssGet('pvPopupClosed') === '1' || closedRecently()) {
            return;
        }
        popupOpen = true;
        document.removeEventListener('mouseout', onExitIntent, false);
        ssSet('pvPopupShown', '1');
        lastFocus = document.activeElement;
        applySeasonPopup();
        applyEarlyAccess();
        root.hidden = false;

        // Focus vao dialog (tabindex=-1), khong vao o email: tranh bat ban phim tren mobile.
        try { dialog.focus(); } catch (e) {}
        track('view', variant === 'exit' ? 'exit' : 'popup');
    }
    function closePopup(skipTrack) {
        if (!popupOpen) {
            return;
        }
        popupOpen = false;
        root.hidden = true;
        document.documentElement.className = document.documentElement.className.replace(/\s*pv-epop-open/g, '');
        if (lastFocus && lastFocus.focus) {
            try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch (e) {}
        }
        if (!skipTrack) {
            track('close', 'popup');
        }
        lsSet('pvPopupClosedAt', String(now()));
        if (ssGet('pvPopupClosed') !== '1') {
            ssSet('pvPopupClosed', '1');
            ssSet('pvWidgetViews', '0');

        if (!isSubscribed()) {
            armWidgetTimer();
        }
    }
    function showStep2() {
        root.querySelector('[data-epop-step="1"]').hidden = true;
        root.querySelector('[data-epop-step="2"]').hidden = false;
        // Anh hero mobile chi o buoc 1.
        var hero = root.querySelector('.pv-epop__hero');

            hero.hidden = true;

        dialog.setAttribute('aria-labelledby', 'pv-epop-title2');
        dialog.setAttribute('aria-describedby', 'pv-epop-sub2');
        var t = document.getElementById('pv-epop-title2');
        if (t) {
            t.focus();

    function submitStep2() {
        var shoppingFor = '';
        var interests = [];
        var choice = root.querySelector('[data-epop-for][aria-pressed="true"]');
        if (choice) {
            shoppingFor = choice.getAttribute('data-epop-for');

        var chips = root.querySelectorAll('[data-epop-interest][aria-pressed="true"]');
        for (var i = 0; i < chips.length; i++) {
            interests.push(chips[i].getAttribute('data-epop-interest'));
        }
        if (popupEmail && (shoppingFor || interests.length)) {
            var props = {'$email': popupEmail};
            if (shoppingFor) {
                // Flow Welcome HV (Klaviyo) re nhanh theo thuoc tinh "Shopping intent" voi dung 2 gia tri nay (form Quiz cu).
                props['Shopping intent'] = shoppingFor === 'gift' ? 'Buying A Gift' : 'Shopping For Myself';
            }
            if (interests.length) {
                props.interests = interests;
            }
            window._klOnsite = window._klOnsite || [];
            window._klOnsite.push(['identify', props]);
        }
        track('step2_submit', 'popup');
        closePopup(true);
    }

    function sendEmail(form) {
        if (form.getAttribute('data-busy') === '1') {
            return;
        }
        var variant = form.getAttribute('data-epop-form');
        var input = form.querySelector('input[name="email"]');
        var button = form.querySelector('button[type="submit"]');
        var status = form.parentNode.querySelector('.pv-epop__status, .pv-ewid__status');
        var email = input ? input.value.replace(/^\s+|\s+$/g, '') : '';
        if (!EMAIL_RE.test(email)) {
            setStatus(status, root.getAttribute('data-msg-invalid'), false);
            if (input) {
                input.focus();
            }
            return;
        }
        setStatus(status, '', true);
        form.setAttribute('data-busy', '1');
        if (button) {
            button.disabled = true;
        }
        var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
        xhr.open('POST', ACTION, true);
        xhr.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8');
        xhr.setRequestHeader('X-Requested-With', 'XMLHttpRequest');
        xhr.setRequestHeader('Accept', 'application/json');
        xhr.onreadystatechange = function () {
            if (xhr.readyState !== 4) {
                return;
            }
            var ok = false;
            var serverMsg = '';
            if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
                try {
                    var res = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
                    ok = !!(res && res.status === 'successful');
                    if (res && typeof res.message === 'string') {
                        serverMsg = res.message;
                    }
                } catch (e) {
                    ok = false;
                }
            }
            form.removeAttribute('data-busy');
            if (button) {
                button.disabled = false;
            }
            if (!ok) {
                setStatus(status, serverMsg || root.getAttribute('data-msg-error'), false);
                return;
            }
            lsSet('pvEcapSubscribed', '1');
            track('submit', variant === 'popup' ? 'popup' : 'widget');
            if (variant === 'popup') {
                popupEmail = email;
                // Early Access BF26: o dang tick -> them thuoc tinh vao profile (cung co che _klOnsite identify nhu buoc 2, khong gui consent).
                if (eaChecked()) {
                    window._klOnsite = window._klOnsite || [];
                    window._klOnsite.push(['identify', {'$email': email, 'Early Access BF26': true, 'Early Access Source': 'popup', 'Early Access At': new Date().toISOString()}]);
                    window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];
                    window.dataLayer.push({event: 'early_access', ea_action: 'join', ea_source: 'popup'});
                    var sub2 = document.getElementById('pv-epop-sub2');
                    if (sub2 && eaBox.getAttribute('data-sub2')) {
                        sub2.textContent = eaBox.getAttribute('data-sub2');
                    }
                }
                showStep2();
            } else {
                form.hidden = true;
                setStatus(status, root.getAttribute('data-msg-ok'), true);
            }
        };
        // Early Access BF26 (#450a6f28 16/11): bao may chu o tick dang chon -> may chu ghi them thuoc tinh qua profile-import.
        xhr.send('email=' + encodeURIComponent(email) + '&refer=' + encodeURIComponent(variant) + (variant === 'popup' && eaChecked() ? '&ea=1' : ''));
    }

    function showWidget() {
        if (popupOpen || !widget.hidden || isSubscribed() || klaviyoKnown() || ssGet('pvWidgetClosed') === '1') {
            return;
        }
        whenConsentClosed(function () {
            if (popupOpen || !widget.hidden || isSubscribed() || ssGet('pvWidgetClosed') === '1') {
                return;
            }
            // PDP mobile: chi hien widget khi khach da cuon qua khoi gia (Frank 03/11/2026 16:47 VN, #450a6f28).
            if (IS_PDP && window.innerWidth <= 767 && !pastPrice()) {
                waitPastPrice();
                return;
            }
            var measure = IS_PDP && window.innerWidth <= 767;
            if (measure) {
                widget.className += ' is-measuring';
            }
            applySeasonWidget();
            widget.hidden = false;
            placeWidget();
            if (!placeTimer) {
                placeTimer = window.setInterval(placeWidget, 1000);
            }
            if (measure) {
                settleWidget(null, 0);
            }
            // Widget PDP luot dau (truoc popup lon) khong tinh: sau khi dong popup widget van theo luat 3 trang / 120 s.
            if (ssGet('pvPopupClosed') === '1') {
                ssSet('pvWidgetShown', '1');
            }
            track('widget_view', 'widget');
        });
    }
    // Khoi gia PDP (.price-row-wrapper / .product-price-group, do US + UK 03/11/2026) da cuon len khoi man hinh chua.
    function pastPrice() {
        var p = document.querySelector('.price-row-wrapper') || document.querySelector('.product-price-group');
        if (p) {
            var r = p.getBoundingClientRect();
            if (r.height > 0) {
                return r.bottom < 0;
            }
        }
        var y = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
        return y > 600;
    }
    var pastPriceWaiting = false;
    function waitPastPrice() {
        if (pastPriceWaiting) {
            return;
        }
        pastPriceWaiting = true;
        var onScroll = function () {
            if (!pastPrice()) {
                return;
            }
            window.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll);
            pastPriceWaiting = false;
            showWidget();
        };
        window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive: true});
    }
    // PDP mobile: thanh mua hang co dinh o day (.addtocart-button-wrapper) -> dat widget ngay tren no, khong de nut Add to cart.
    function placeWidget() {
        if (widget.hidden) {
            return;

    function selectCurrencyHeader(currency, text) {
        currencySwitchHeader = currency;
        document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = text;
        document.getElementById("list-currency-show-header").checked = false;
    }

    function saveSwitchHeader() {
        if (currencySwitchHeader) {
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader("currency", currencySwitchHeader, 365);
            setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
            try {
                sessionStorage.setItem('localization_scroll', window.scrollY || window.pageYOffset || 0);
            } catch (e) {}
            if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                history.scrollRestoration = 'manual';
            }
            window.location.reload();
        }
    }

    // Khôi phục vị trí cuộn sau khi đổi tiền tệ reload (giữ nguyên chỗ đang đứng).
    // Apply nhiều lần vì checkout render bằng Angular async, chiều cao trang thay đổi.
    (function () {
        var saved = sessionStorage.getItem('localization_scroll');
        if (saved !== null) {
            var top = parseInt(saved, 10) || 0;
            sessionStorage.removeItem('localization_scroll');
            var apply = function () {
                var times = [0, 200, 500, 900, 1500];
                for (var i = 0; i < times.length; i++) {
                    setTimeout(function () { window.scrollTo(0, top); }, times[i]);
                }
                setTimeout(function () {
                    if ('scrollRestoration' in history) {
                        history.scrollRestoration = 'auto';
                    }
                }, 1700);
            };
            if (document.readyState === 'complete') {
                apply();
            } else {
                window.addEventListener('load', apply);
            }
        }
    })();

    function getCookieSelectCountryHeader(name) {
        let isSelectCountry = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) isSelectCountry = true;
        return isSelectCountry;
    }

    function getCookieHeader(name) {
        let cookieValue = false;
        const value = `; ${document.cookie}`;
        const parts = value.split(`; ${name}=`);
        if (parts.length === 2) {
            cookieValue = parts[1];
        }
        return cookieValue;
    }

    function closeCountryHeader() {
        document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.remove("active");
        setCookieSelectCountryHeader('is_currency_selected', 1, 365);
    }

    function setCookieSelectCountryHeader(cname, cvalue, exdays) {
        const d = new Date();
        d.setTime(d.getTime() + (exdays * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
        let expires = "expires=" + d.toUTCString();
        document.cookie = cname + "=" + cvalue + ";" + expires + ";path=/";
    }

    let isShowByCookie = false;
    if (!getCookieSelectCountryHeader("is_currency_selected")) {
        if (document.getElementById("header-select-country")) {
            isShowByCookie = true;
        }
    }

    var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    xhr.open('GET', url + '/localization/info', true);

    xhr.onload = function () {
        if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
            var responseData = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
            if (responseData.status == 'successful') {
                let result = responseData.result;
                let isMismatch = result['countryByIp'] && result['countryByIp'].toLowerCase() != result['currentLocale'];
                let isShowHeader = result['isShow'] && isMismatch ? 1 : 0;

                if (document.getElementById("header-select-country") && isShowHeader == 1 && isShowByCookie) {
                    currencySwitchHeader = result['currencyByCountry'];
                    let displayText = currencySwitchHeader;
                    if (listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader]) {
                        let c = listCurrencyMap[currencySwitchHeader];
                        displayText = c.symbol + ' ' + c.symbolText + ' (' + currencySwitchHeader + ')';
                    }
                    document.getElementById("currency-inner-text-header").textContent = displayText;
                    document.getElementById("header-select-country").classList.add("active");
                }
            }
        } else {
            console.error('Request failed with status: ' + xhr.status);
        }
    };

    xhr.onerror = function () {
        console.error('Network error occurred');
    };

    xhr.send();
